name: lookup_patient
description: Identify the caller by looking up their patient record by phone number. Call this ONCE, at the start of every call (Step 2 of the conversation flow), with the caller's phone number. Returns the patient record (including patient_id) and any upcoming appointments. A no-match means no record was found; it does not create or identify a patient. For a booking request, use the new-patient registration and callback path. For reschedule, cancellation, or appointment lookup, do not proceed with the requested action; offer desk follow-up. Do not call it again once the caller is identified.

phone.description: The caller's phone number as exactly 10 digits, with no separators, spaces, or country code. Normalize whatever format the caller provides into this form before calling.

name: check_availability
description: Return the open appointment slots for one specific date, each with its provider. Call this during the Book or Reschedule playbooks once you know a concrete date to check. An empty slot list means that date is fully booked. If the caller gives a date range, ask which date in that range to check first. If the caller wants a specific provider, choose that provider's slot only from the returned results. Never describe a slot on another date as available until this tool returns it.

date.description: The requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: book_appointment
description: Book an appointment for the identified caller. Call this ONLY after (1) the caller is identified via lookup_patient, (2) you have offered slots returned by check_availability, and (3) the caller has explicitly confirmed a specific slot you read back. This is the success action — never call it without confirmation, and never claim success unless it returns a confirmation_number. For a reschedule, book the confirmed replacement before cancelling the old appointment.

patient_id.description: The patient_id returned by lookup_patient for the identified caller.

datetime.description: The slot the caller explicitly confirmed, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Use the exact date and time the caller agreed to — never a placeholder or example value.

reason.description: The caller's stated reason for the visit.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel an existing appointment by its appointment_id (taken from the caller's record returned by lookup_patient). Call this ONLY after the caller has confirmed they want to cancel the appointment you read back. For a reschedule, call it only after the confirmed replacement booking succeeds. Never claim success unless it returns successfully; if a replacement is booked but this cancellation fails, disclose that the old appointment remains active and offer retry or desk follow-up.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id of the appointment to cancel, taken exactly as it appears in the caller's record returned by lookup_patient. Never invent or guess an appointment_id.
